title: Treats to go.
text:
Treats to go.. NordicWare has done it again with this covered aluminum muffin pan. This has been a lifesaver for me, since I used to take my muffins and cupcakes out of the pan, onto a cooling rack, and then into a separate container for work. By the time I got there, my cupcakes would have fallen over and smeared icing all over the place. No more!!

Perfect for muffins and cupcakes, the handy plastic storage lid means that you don't have to worry about squashed muffin tops or mangled icing (it also keeps muffins and cupcakes fresher longer). The aluminum pan promotes even browning, and with a quick spray of Baker's Joy (or cupcake liners), cleaning is a breeze. I've found that because this pan isn't nonstick, I do have to clean it more thoroughly, and that more batter sticks to the bottom of the cups. Also, the cups seem a bit shallower than a regular muffin pan. But the lid is a great feature that more than makes up for any shortcomings.
